title: OmniBrain-0: A Unified Agentic Model for Embodied Intelligence
abstract: arXiv:2610.36013v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: General-purpose embodied intelligence requires robots to coordinate diverse skills over long horizons, track task progress, and recover from failures. Specialist policies alone do not ensure task-level reliability, while powerful multimodal agents rely on costly reasoning and external experience that compact models struggle to reproduce. We introduce OmniBrain-0, a lightweight unified embodied agent that coordinates manipulation and navigation through a shared high-level decision model, integrating task understanding, planning, progress tracking, and feedback-driven recovery. Our progressive training framework combines embodied pretraining, domain-specialized agent distillation, and multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD). It distills powerful teachers' interaction experience into manipulation and navigation experts, then consolidates their decision capabilities into OmniBrain-0. translated_title: OmniBrain-0：一个面向具身智能的统一智能体模型
translated_abstract: 通用具身智能要求机器人在长时程任务中协调多种技能、跟踪任务进度并从失败中恢复。仅靠专家策略无法保证任务级别的可靠性，而强大的多模态智能体则依赖昂贵的推理和外部经验，这是紧凑模型难以复现的。我们提出了OmniBrain-0，一个轻量级的统一具身智能体，它通过共享的高层决策模型协调操作与导航，整合了任务理解、规划、进度跟踪和基于反馈的失败恢复。我们的渐进式训练框架结合了具身预训练、领域专用智能体蒸馏以及多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）。该框架首先将强大教师的交互经验蒸馏到操作和导航专家模型中，随后将它们的决策能力整合到OmniBrain-0中。因此，统一化发生在学习到的决策过程之中。
tldr: OmniBrain-0是一个轻量级统一具身智能体，通过具身预训练、领域专用智能体蒸馏和多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）的渐进式训练框架，利用共享的高层决策模型协调操作与导航，实现任务理解、规划、进度跟踪和失败恢复。
